title: Sid Nathan hears the dub in Cincinnati
summary: Glover sent the tape to Sid Nathan, who loved it and planned to record it in Cincinnati.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Then we had the guy to make a dub of it. Didn't take the tape, just left (inaudible).
Then we sent it out to Cincinatti -- Glover sent it out to Cincinatti so Sid Nathan could hear it.
Sid say, "Hey, this is great. Look like Teddy got him another hit here," you know.
So he says, "I tell you what I'm gonna do.
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
I'm gonna go in the studio and get" -- see, Wynona (inaudible) in town -- some of the guys out there. He had a lot of musicians.
They were recording a lot out there and they had other guys recorded rhythm and blues stuff with (inaudible) Cincinatti.
